2026-10-05: Follow-up from #427, based on the retained source crosswalk and reproducible EPSG:5070 intersection-over-union comparisons in its PR evidence packet.

Exact affected Atlas location IDs (six):
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B10934602069357` — Jackson County, Mississippi, GEOID 28059 (2018 source vs TIGERweb 2026 IoU 0.73690648)
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B16895111765374` — Moore County, Tennessee, GEOID 47127 (2018 CBF IoU 0.94568923; TIGERweb 2026 IoU 0.94540945)
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B27952664457255` — Harrison County, Mississippi, GEOID 28047 (2026 IoU 0.61770242)
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B49198903326940` — Hancock County, Mississippi, GEOID 28045 (2026 IoU 0.87602581)
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B60515004813393` — Baldwin County, Alabama, GEOID 01003 (2026 IoU 0.82322412)
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B65626355292212` — Mobile County, Alabama, GEOID 01097 (2026 IoU 0.78163973)

Research objective: compare the exact retained geoBoundaries feature bytes and lineage against the 2018 Census cartographic and 2026 TIGERweb responses for these six units; determine whether each low score reflects vintage, generalization, coastline/island representation, multipart conventions, or an actual identity/geometry problem. Preserve all six IDs and state parents unless an authoritative source demonstrates a concrete correction. Do not change core geography or treat the 0.95 triage threshold as a boundary standard. Keep semantic county identity separate from boundary accuracy. Record precise source versions, license, retrieval receipt, geographic completeness and uncertainty. If correction is supported, produce an engineering handoff with exact source geometry hashes and neighboring units; if not, document the reconciliation.

Source evidence: #427's retained `findings/usa-county-crosswalk.csv`, `findings/reproduction-summary.json`, `REVIEW.md`, and source receipts; pinned geoBoundaries release commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`; Census 2018 cartographic ZIP SHA-256 `aaa866af327754e1b80aa87bfb97b04a7209f4f871075aef84affb8f0b3afe67`; four state TIGERweb 2026 query receipts/hashes are in the same packet. The #427 report is expected to link this issue after creation.

Readiness reviewed by the Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles: #427 is closed and its claim released, and PR #984 preserves the packet. Two independently bounded executions reproduced all six reported scores exactly in the current scientific runtime. This does not approve any correction. The original historical runtime remains unavailable; retain that limitation. Adopted evidence-quality contract below preserves the original six IDs, one-PR budget and owned path. No current open PR overlaps this path. #1148 separately covers two different invalid Census comparators; its subjects are outside this six-ID scope. Record original source CRS (CBF is NAD83/GRS1980) rather than treating all coordinates as WGS84, and disclose any approximation. Public metadata and product reuse terms must be distinguished.
